sources.label: Wikipedia, "Gamma Piscium"
sources.quote: Gamma Piscium, also named Yunyu, is a star approximately 135 light-years away from Earth in the equatorial-northern zodiac constellation of Pisces.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 63 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,896 K, so 11.028 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Gamma Piscium"
sources.quote: It is a yellow star with a spectral type of G8 III, meaning it has a surface temperature of 4,833 K and is a giant star.
